business_insight: GeoPulse analyzes simulated GPS device activity for hyper-local retail mobility analysis.
The dataset contains 10000 recorded GPS pings.
The dataset contains activity from 1000 unique devices.
Peak recorded GPS activity occurs around 14:00.
Hadapsar Commercial Zone is the highest-ranked zone based on recorded GPS activity.
GPS pings represent recorded device activity and should not be interpreted as confirmed store visits.
The dataset does not identify actual customer identities.
